title: renameUnit
responsibility: Gives a unit another readable id, keeping its uid, contract and history and updating every specification reference.

inputs.name: renameUnit.from
inputs.description: The current id of an active unit.

inputs.name: renameUnit.to
inputs.description: The new id; a lowercase dotted or dashed identifier no unit has ever used.

inputs.name: renameUnit.options
inputs.description: The project root and the clock used for the tombstone time.

outputs.name: renameUnit
outputs.description: A report of the old and new id and the specification files rewritten.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the unit is unknown or retired, the new id is invalid, or the new id exists already.
